name: IntegralFrame.exists_stdRowDatum_eq_stdDatum
summary: Multiply the stacked matrix (L′; x) by the integral invertible (L | K | I): the product is block triangular with determinant det(x·(K | I)), so the two standard data differ by the constant χ⁻¹ of a unit determinant.

steps.claim: Take c = χ⁻¹(det of the frame matrix), of absolute value 1 (`TameLocalChar.norm_eq_one`). For each x: the square matrix (L′; x), reordered by σ, times the integral invertible matrix (L | K | I) reordered by σ⁻¹ is the block matrix with first block L′L = 1 and lower-right block x·(K | I) (the frame identities, `IntegralFrame.blocks_spec`); so it lies in GL_m(O) exactly when x is integral and det(x·(K | I)) is a unit (`isPrimitiveMatrix_iff_isIntegralUnit_det`), and the χ⁻¹ of the determinants differ by the factor c (`invOnUnits_eq_mul_of_unit`).
steps.lean:
refine' A.blocks_spec |> fun _ ↦
    (⟨_, hχ.norm_eq_one ·, funext fun x ↦ if_congr _ (invOnUnits_eq_mul_of_unit ‹_› ▸ _) _⟩)
    (isPrimitiveMatrix_iff_isIntegralUnit_det (A := (A.L.fromCols (A.K.fromCols A.I)).submatrix id
    σ.symm).1 ⟨_, (A.L'.fromRows (A.K'.fromRows A.I')).submatrix σ.symm id, _⟩).2 <;>
    simp_all [IsIntMatrix, reindex_equiv σ, ↓fromRows_mul_fromCols, ← det_mul, ← submatrix_mul]
